theory.title: Exercise 2.3.1: IF Basics
theory.content:
🚦 Decision Points

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, imagine a fork in the road. IF the left path is safe, take it. Otherwise, skip it. That's an IF statement."

"IF checks a condition. If TRUE, the code inside runs. If FALSE, Robot Framework skips that block entirely."

❓ What is an IF Statement?

IF Statement - Conditional execution based on a boolean expression

  • ✅ Condition check - Evaluate TRUE or FALSE
  • ✅ Conditional execution - Run code only if TRUE
  • ✅ Skip if FALSE - Ignore block when condition fails
  • ✅ Decision-making - Tests adapt to runtime data

When to Use IF:

  • 🔹 Check if value meets threshold
  • 🔹 Validate data before processing
  • 🔹 Handle different test environments
  • 🔹 Skip steps based on conditions

📝 IF Statement Syntax

*** Test Cases ***
Check Temperature
    ${temp}=    Set Variable    75
    IF    ${temp} > 70
        Log    Temperature is high
        Log    Activating cooling
    END
    Log    Temperature check done

Execution Flow:

  1. 🔹 Set ${temp} = 75
  2. 🔹 Check: Is 75 > 70? → TRUE
  3. 🔹 Run IF block: Log high temp, Log cooling
  4. 🔹 END closes IF block
  5. 🔹 Continue: Log check done

📋 IF Statement Rules

  • 🔹 Syntax: IF condition (capital IF)
  • 🔹 Indentation: IF block indented 4 spaces
  • 🔹 Closing: Must end with END
  • 🔹 Condition: Boolean expression (TRUE/FALSE)
  • 🔹 Operators: ==, !=, <, >, <=, >=

🎯 Your Task

Create a test that checks if power level > 50. If TRUE, log a message. Use IF...END structure!
